source_tests.environment: Isolated temporary state, synthetic data, fake providers and loopback HTTP servers.

language_regressions: Concurrent English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese conversations remain isolated by project and chat
API edit/save/enable/disable, Vertex setup, approval pages and expired links retain the originating conversation language
Setup token renewal and process reconnect preserve language
Presentation changes preserve approved plan hashes, recorded model answers and anonymous ballots
Internal en-US and task-specific deliverable_language remain independent
Other languages require a complete versioned template from current Codex; malformed HTML or moved placeholders are rejected
Stale templates never block status, result retrieval or cancellation; functional forms require refreshed translations

independent_review.result: No remaining reliability or isolation blockers found; both reported issues fixed
findings_resolved: Bind positional format values to their positions relative to HTML markup
Use imperative Enable/Disable labels for English API actions
independent_review.checks: Four catalog tests and independent temporary-database checks of isolation, token renewal, persistence, stale catalogs, and unchanged plan hashes

language_policy.user_reports_and_functional_forms: Current Codex conversation language, honoring explicit preferences and Chinese script
language_policy.additional_languages: Complete versioned interface translation by current Codex; no new external model request

task_alignment.description: Answers the whole approved question and satisfies its requested deliverable and constraints.

correctness_evidence.description: Claims are accurate relative to supplied evidence; distinguish established facts, inference and unknowns. Creative work does not need irrelevant citations. Peer agreement is not evidence.

reasoning.description: Conclusions follow from premises; consider consequential alternatives, counterevidence and failure modes without manufacturing doubts.

actionability.description: The answer can be used for the actual task; recommendations are feasible and concrete. For explanatory/creative work, judge usefulness rather than demand an implementation plan.

clarity.description: Clear, precise, appropriately concise and suited to the requested audience and format; length, polish and confidence alone earn no credit.

anchors.0: Absent, unusable, or directly contradicts a central requirement/evidence.
anchors.2: Partly useful, but material gaps or unsupported claims remain.
anchors.3: Adequately meets the criterion with clearly bounded limitations.
anchors.4: Strongly meets the criterion; only minor, specific improvements needed.
anchors.5: Exceptionally well supported and task-complete on this criterion; no material defect found in supplied evidence. This is not a claim of certainty.

harness.scale: integer 0–5; weighted assessment /100, never a probability
harness.review_policy: Each reviewer sees all answers in a frozen independently shuffled order. All complete valid ballots have equal weight, including self-review as upstream. Also report leave-self-out sensitivity. No current-round reviews or author mapping in review packets. Any approved history is shared context, not new evidence or independent votes.
harness.codex_policy: One independent Codex participant; fresh isolated proposer and a different fresh isolated reviewer. Current chairman does not cast a second vote.

limitations: Conversation-language detection and translated user reports are performed by the host Codex workflow, not an operating-system or browser setting.
Automated checks enforce catalog completeness, fixed markup and placeholders; translation fidelity requires assistant judgment.
Tests use synthetic providers and do not measure live models' compliance with English instructions.
Technical records, approved internal plans, code, identifiers and source quotations retain their recorded language.
Changed runtime contracts require new approval for new paid work; historical completed answers and reports remain readable.
